mapper.select: SELECT skill.*, active.skill_md AS content, active.skill_md_digest AS content_digest, COALESCE(active.version, 0) AS revision, COALESCE(active.package_sha256, '') AS package_sha256, COALESCE(active.package_size_bytes, 0) AS package_size_bytes, COALESCE((SELECT max(history.version) FROM platform_skill_versions history WHERE history.skill_id = skill.id), 0) AS latest_version, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM platform_skill_versions history WHERE history.skill_id = skill.id) AS version_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_skill_installations installation WHERE installation.skill_id = skill.id) AS install_count FROM platform_skills skill LEFT JOIN platform_skill_versions active ON active.id = skill.active_version_id ORDER BY skill.category, skill.name, skill.id

SELECT skill.*, active.skill_md AS content, active.skill_md_digest AS content_digest, COALESCE(active.version, 0) AS revision, COALESCE(active.package_sha256, '') AS package_sha256, COALESCE(active.package_size_bytes, 0) AS package_size_bytes, COALESCE((SELECT max(history.version) FROM platform_skill_versions history WHERE history.skill_id = skill.id), 0) AS latest_version, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM platform_skill_versions history WHERE history.skill_id = skill.id) AS version_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_skill_installations installation WHERE installation.skill_id = skill.id) AS install_count FROM platform_skills skill LEFT JOIN platform_skill_versions active ON active.id = skill.active_version_id WHERE skill.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_skills (id, name, description, category, icon, launch_mode, starter_prompt, status, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{category}, #{icon}, #{launchMode}, #{starterPrompt}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_skills SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, icon = #{icon}, launch_mode = #{launchMode}, starter_prompt = #{starterPrompt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_skill_versions (id, skill_id, version, package_key, package_sha256, package_size_bytes, skill_md, skill_md_digest, manifest, changelog, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{skillId}, #{version}, #{packageKey}, #{packageSha256}, #{packageSizeBytes}, #{skillMd}, #{skillMdDigest}, #{manifest, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{changelog}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT version.*, (skill.active_version_id = version.id) AS active FROM platform_skill_versions version JOIN platform_skills skill ON skill.id = version.skill_id WHERE version.skill_id = #{skillId} ORDER BY version.version DESC

SELECT version.*, (skill.active_version_id = version.id) AS active FROM platform_skill_versions version JOIN platform_skills skill ON skill.id = version.skill_id WHERE version.skill_id = #{skillId} AND version.version = #{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_skills SET active_version_id = #{versionId}, status = CASE WHEN status = 'draft' THEN 'active' ELSE status END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{skillId}
mapper.select: SELECT skill.*, active.skill_md AS content, active.skill_md_digest AS content_digest, active.version AS revision, (installation.skill_id IS NOT NULL) AS installed, installation.installed_at FROM platform_skills skill JOIN platform_skill_versions active ON active.id = skill.active_version_id LEFT JOIN organization_skill_installations installation ON installation.skill_id = skill.id AND installation.organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY (installation.skill_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, skill.category, skill.name, skill.id

SELECT skill.*, active.skill_md AS content, active.skill_md_digest AS content_digest, active.version AS revision, true AS installed, installation.installed_at FROM platform_skills skill JOIN platform_skill_versions active ON active.id = skill.active_version_id JOIN organization_skill_installations installation ON installation.skill_id = skill.id WHERE installation.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND skill.id = #{skillId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_skill_installations (organization_id, skill_id, installed_by, configuration) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{skillId}, #{installedBy}, #{configuration, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (organization_id, skill_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM organization_skill_installations WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND skill_id = #{skillId}
mapper.select: SELECT skill.*, active.skill_md AS content, active.skill_md_digest AS content_digest, active.version AS revision FROM organization_skill_installations installation JOIN platform_skills skill ON skill.id = installation.skill_id JOIN platform_skill_versions active ON active.id = skill.active_version_id WHERE installation.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND skill.status = 'active' ORDER BY installation.display_order, installation.installed_at, skill.name, skill.id

SELECT skill.*, active.skill_md AS content, active.skill_md_digest AS content_digest, active.version AS revision FROM organization_skill_installations installation JOIN platform_skills skill ON skill.id = installation.skill_id JOIN platform_skill_versions active ON active.id = skill.active_version_id WHERE installation.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND skill.id = #{skillId} AND skill.status = 'active'
SELECT *, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM credential_handles ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credential_handles (id, name, provider, handle, metadata, secret_ciphertext, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{handle}, #{metadata, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{secretCiphertext}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT *, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM model_profiles ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_profiles (id, name, provider, model, credential_handle_id, configuration, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{credentialHandleId}, #{configuration, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE model_profiles SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), provider = COALESCE(#{provider}, provider), model = COALESCE(#{model}, model), credential_handle_id = CASE WHEN #{credentialHandleId} IS NOT NULL OR #{status} IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(#{credentialHandleId}, credential_handle_id) ELSE credential_handle_id END, configuration = COALESCE(#{configuration, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, configuration), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'inputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS input_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'outputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS output_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'totalTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS total_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'cacheReadTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS cache_read_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'cacheWriteTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS cache_write_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'reasoningTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS reasoning_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'llmCalls')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS llm_calls, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'estimatedCostUsd')::numeric), 0)::numeric AS estimated_cost_usd FROM agent_messages WHERE role = 'agent' AND created_at >= now() - (#{days} * interval '1 day') AND (#{organizationId}::text IS NULL OR organization_id = #{organizationId}) AND usage <> '{}'::jsonb

WITH dates AS ( SELECT generate_series( current_date - ((#{days} - 1) * interval '1 day'), current_date, interval '1 day' )::date AS day ), daily AS ( SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'inputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS input_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'outputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS output_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'totalTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS total_tokens, COALESCE(sum((usage ->> 'llmCalls')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS llm_calls FROM agent_messages WHERE role = 'agent' AND created_at >= current_date - ((#{days} - 1) * interval '1 day') AND (#{organizationId}::text IS NULL OR organization_id = #{organizationId}) AND usage <> '{}'::jsonb GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COALESCE(daily.input_tokens, 0)::bigint AS input_tokens, COALESCE(daily.output_tokens, 0)::bigint AS output_tokens, COALESCE(daily.total_tokens, 0)::bigint AS total_tokens, COALESCE(daily.llm_calls, 0)::bigint AS llm_calls FROM dates LEFT JOIN daily ON daily.day = dates.day ORDER BY dates.day

SELECT organization.id, organization.name, organization.slug AS secondary, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'inputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS input_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'outputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS output_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'totalTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS total_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'llmCalls')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS llm_calls FROM agent_messages message JOIN organizations organization ON organization.id = message.organization_id WHERE message.role = 'agent' AND message.created_at >= now() - (#{days} * interval '1 day') AND (#{organizationId}::text IS NULL OR message.organization_id = #{organizationId}) AND message.usage <> '{}'::jsonb GROUP BY organization.id, organization.name, organization.slug ORDER BY total_tokens DESC, organization.name LIMIT 10

SELECT user_account.id, user_account.display_name AS name, user_account.username AS secondary, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'inputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS input_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'outputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS output_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'totalTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS total_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'llmCalls')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS llm_calls FROM agent_messages message JOIN agents agent ON agent.id = message.agent_id JOIN users user_account ON user_account.id = agent.user_id WHERE message.role = 'agent' AND message.created_at >= now() - (#{days} * interval '1 day') AND (#{organizationId}::text IS NULL OR message.organization_id = #{organizationId}) AND message.usage <> '{}'::jsonb GROUP BY user_account.id, user_account.display_name, user_account.username ORDER BY total_tokens DESC, user_account.display_name LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE(model.id, 'unassigned') AS id, COALESCE(model.name, '未记录模型') AS name, COALESCE(model.model, '—') AS secondary, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'inputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS input_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'outputTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS output_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'totalTokens')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS total_tokens, COALESCE(sum((message.usage ->> 'llmCalls')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS llm_calls FROM agent_messages message JOIN agent_conversations conversation ON conversation.id = message.conversation_id LEFT JOIN model_profiles model ON model.id = conversation.model_id WHERE message.role = 'agent' AND message.created_at >= now() - (#{days} * interval '1 day') AND (#{organizationId}::text IS NULL OR message.organization_id = #{organizationId}) AND message.usage <> '{}'::jsonb GROUP BY model.id, model.name, model.model ORDER BY total_tokens DESC, name LIMIT 10
SELECT id FROM credential_handles WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id::text AS id, actor_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, payload, occurred_at, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM audit_events WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (#{action}::text IS NULL OR action = #{action}) AND (#{resourceType}::text IS NULL OR resource_type = #{resourceType}) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_events (organization_id, actor_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, payload) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{actorUserId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{payload, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler})
